digest.component_or_area: LLM model class system and workflow resolution
propositions: Model tier selection is currently inferred from equality tests against the default provider, causing silent disabling of per-pass downgrades on non-default model ids.
A single scalar REBAR_LLM_MODEL cannot express per-tier mappings, forcing operators to choose one model for all four review passes rather than tier-specific choices.
Pass-1 plan-review finders with bare Anthropic names resolve to direct Anthropic on Bedrock runs due to substring matching in sizing.MODEL_LADDER, creating split-brain dispatch across providers.
Config layering via REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must deep-merge tables (preserving sibling keys) and replace arrays wholesale, not use shallow merge semantics that lose provider/endpoint/fallback chains.
Class names must resolve at three independent call sites (config.resolve_model, ladder expansion, verifier paths) via a single resolve_model_string function to prevent cross-provider drift.

End-to-end verification shows per-pass class resolution across two providers produces expected split (41 frontier calls to Anthropic, 1 standard call to Bedrock) proving per-tier capability across provider boundaries.
